Now I understand! The test framework has special handling for escape sequences. Looking at line 53:
```python
self.data = self.data.replace(b"\n", b"").replace(b"\\r\\n", b"\r\n")
```

It's converting literal `\r\n` text sequences to actual CRLF bytes. But there's also `self.data = self.data.replace(b"\n", b"")` which removes all actual newlines first.

The issue is that the test files have been corrupted - they now contain literal `\r\n` text instead of actual CRLF bytes. The test framework expects to find literal `\r\n` in the file and convert them, but the original files should have had actual CRLF bytes.
